# Conformance kit and fixtures

The files under `spec/` and `test/fixtures/` that a test holds the code to, and the 23 tests in [test/conformance](https://github.com/gtme-run/gtme/tree/main/test/conformance) that load them. `go test ./test/conformance/` runs them alone, and `make check` runs them with the rest of the suite.

## File sets

What each set holds comes from `spec/README.md`, or from the schema's title. A set is listed under every test whose code, or a helper it calls, reads it.

| Files | Holds | Loaded by |
|---|---|---|
| `spec/schemas/msg-*.schema.json` (12: msg-attest.schema.json, msg-cost.schema.json, msg-end.schema.json, msg-log.schema.json, msg-open.schema.json, msg-pending.schema.json, msg-preflight.schema.json, msg-record-in.schema.json, msg-record-out.schema.json, msg-schema.schema.json, msg-state.schema.json, msg-verdict.schema.json) | Every wire-protocol message type, per direction | `TestWireTranscriptValidatesAgainstSchemas`, `TestTranscriptRoundTripsThroughProtocol`, `TestEveryProtocolSchemaIsCompilable`, `TestCostSchemaAcceptsBasis` |
| `spec/wire/*.ndjson` (1: basic-run.ndjson) | Golden transcripts recorded from the real adapters | `TestWireTranscriptValidatesAgainstSchemas`, `TestTranscriptRoundTripsThroughProtocol` |
| `spec/schemas/pipeline.schema.json` | `pipeline.yaml`, including `uses:`/`variables:`/`on_missing:` | `TestSpecExamplePipelineValidates`, `TestExamplePipelinesValidate`, `TestEveryProtocolSchemaIsCompilable` |
| `spec/schemas/manifest.schema.json` | An adapter's `manifest.json` | `TestAdapterManifestsValidate`, `TestEveryProtocolSchemaIsCompilable` |
| `spec/schemas/field-registry.schema.json` | The `fields/*.json` type files themselves | `TestEveryProtocolSchemaIsCompilable`, `TestRegistryFilesValidateAgainstSchema` |
| `spec/fields/*.json` (3: company.json, person.json, post.json) | A type: its `kind` (subject or signal), its ordered `identity` key tiers, and its canonical fields — names, tiers, normalization rules, value domains, and any `reference` that mints a relation | `TestRegistryFilesValidateAgainstSchema`, `TestEmbeddedRegistryMatchesSpecDir` |
| `spec/ledger.sql` | The canonical ledger DDL, including the `current_fields` view | `TestLedgerSchemaMatchesSpec` |
| `spec/acceptance/*.yaml` (8: guard.yaml, interrogate.yaml, iterate.yaml, launch.yaml, recover.yaml, report.yaml, segment.yaml, top-up.yaml) | The eight operator stories as structured given/when/then | `TestAcceptanceCorpusIsCompleteAndWellFormed` |
| `spec/bindings/*/binding.yaml` (1: apollo-search/binding.yaml) | — | `TestShippedBindingsParse` |
| `spec/bindings/*/fixtures/*` (1: apollo-search/fixtures/conformance.json) | — | `TestShippedBindingsParse` |
| `spec/bundle-manifest.json` | Campaign bundle manifest | `TestBundleManifestsValidate` |
| `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` (5: apollo-enrich/binding.yaml, apollo-search/binding.yaml, attio-assert/binding.yaml, harvest-profile/binding.yaml, harvest-recent-posts/binding.yaml) | — | `TestShippedBindingsParse`, `TestApolloBindingConformance`, `TestApolloEnrichConformance`, `TestHarvestBindingConformance`, `TestAttioBindingConformance`, `TestSimulateGap`, `TestSimulateServesFixtures`, `TestHarvestRecentPostsConformance` |

## Tests

What each test checks is its doc comment.

| Test | File | Kit files it reads | Checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TestAcceptanceCorpusIsCompleteAndWellFormed` | `acceptance_test.go` | `spec/acceptance/*.yaml` | TestAcceptanceCorpusIsCompleteAndWellFormed is a structural check only: it says the acceptance criteria are loadable, complete, and non-empty. It does not assert that any e2e test implements a story. |
| `TestShippedBindingsParse` | `binding_test.go` | `spec/bindings/*/binding.yaml`, `spec/bindings/*/fixtures/*`, `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` | The one binding under spec/bindings/ (the worked example) and every registry entry in the local copy conform to the schema, bridge onto a valid §6 manifest, and name only registry-valid fields in their extraction (§4a enforcement extended to bindings). |
| `TestApolloBindingConformance` | `binding_test.go` | `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` | — |
| `TestApolloEnrichConformance` | `binding_test.go` | `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` | The paid half of the split (ADR-043) — one masked record in, the revealed surface out, one per-credit cost row. |
| `TestHarvestBindingConformance` | `binding_test.go` | `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` | harvest/profile@2 (ADR-059) — one call, role_history through each:, the cost from config at its default. |
| `TestAttioBindingConformance` | `binding_test.go` | `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` | — |
| `TestSimulateGap` | `binding_test.go` | `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` | A binding without fixtures, asked to simulate, surfaces the gap instead of touching the network or silently passing (SPEC §8). |
| `TestSimulateServesFixtures` | `binding_test.go` | `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` | With fixtures present and GTME_SIMULATE set, the engine answers from fixtures without any HTTP seam at all. |
| `TestHarvestRecentPostsConformance` | `binding_test.go` | `test/fixtures/registry/*/binding.yaml` | harvest/recent-posts keeps at most posts_limit non-empty posts, content before text (ADR-059). |
| `TestLedgerSchemaMatchesSpec` | `ledger_schema_test.go` | `spec/ledger.sql` | TestLedgerSchemaMatchesSpec is the ADR-010 schema-conformance test: the canonical DDL in spec/ledger.sql and the schema the migrations actually build must describe the same ledger. |
| `TestSpecExamplePipelineValidates` | `pipeline_test.go` | `spec/schemas/pipeline.schema.json` | TestSpecExamplePipelineValidates checks SPEC §9's own example pipeline against spec/schemas/pipeline.schema.json. The example includes `uses:` (ADR-004). |
| `TestSpecExamplePipelineParses` | `pipeline_test.go` | — | TestSpecExamplePipelineParses is the other half of the §9 contract: the schema saying a document is well-formed is worth nothing if the parser the operator actually hits rejects it. SPEC §9's example carries `uses:` (ADR-004), so this fails until internal/pipeline knows that key. |
| `TestExamplePipelinesValidate` | `pipeline_test.go` | `spec/schemas/pipeline.schema.json` | TestExamplePipelinesValidate checks every pipeline shipped under examples/. |
| `TestAdapterManifestsValidate` | `pipeline_test.go` | `spec/schemas/manifest.schema.json` | TestAdapterManifestsValidate checks every manifest.json in the tree against spec/schemas/manifest.schema.json — built-ins, the external Python adapter, and the test fixture adapters alike, since SPEC §6 makes no distinction. |
| `TestBundleManifestsValidate` | `pipeline_test.go` | `spec/bundle-manifest.json` | TestBundleManifestsValidate checks every frozen pattern bundle's manifest.json under bundles/ against spec/bundle-manifest.json (SPEC §8, ADR-029) — the format the bundler writes and `gtme run \<bundle\>` reads. |
| `TestPluginManifestsAreWellFormed` | `pipeline_test.go` | — | The Claude Code plugin ships from this repo (repo root is the marketplace, plugin/ is the plugin). The two manifests must parse, name what the docs say they name, and the plugin's version must match the binary's tag line — both bump in one commit. |
| `TestWireTranscriptValidatesAgainstSchemas` | `protocol_test.go` | `spec/schemas/msg-*.schema.json`, `spec/wire/*.ndjson` | TestWireTranscriptValidatesAgainstSchemas is the ADR-010 protocol-conformance test: every message in every golden transcript must validate against the spec/schemas/ file for its type and direction. |
| `TestTranscriptRoundTripsThroughProtocol` | `protocol_test.go` | `spec/schemas/msg-*.schema.json`, `spec/wire/*.ndjson` | TestTranscriptRoundTripsThroughProtocol checks the other half of the contract: the golden lines are not just schema-valid, they are what internal/protocol actually reads and writes. A message that changes shape on the way through is a serialization divergence. |
| `TestEveryProtocolSchemaIsCompilable` | `protocol_test.go` | `spec/schemas/msg-*.schema.json`, `spec/schemas/pipeline.schema.json`, `spec/schemas/manifest.schema.json`, `spec/schemas/field-registry.schema.json` | TestEveryProtocolSchemaIsCompilable guards the corpus itself: a schema nobody happens to exercise still has to be loadable draft-07. |
| `TestCostSchemaAcceptsBasis` | `protocol_test.go` | `spec/schemas/msg-*.schema.json` | The COST schema admits ADR-046's basis and nothing else in that slot — a labeled emission from a built-in must validate, and a made-up basis must not. |
| `TestRegistryFilesValidateAgainstSchema` | `registry_test.go` | `spec/schemas/field-registry.schema.json`, `spec/fields/*.json` | — |
| `TestEmbeddedRegistryMatchesSpecDir` | `registry_test.go` | `spec/fields/*.json` | The embedded registry is the same files — the binary can never disagree with the spec/ directory it was built from. |
| `TestShippedManifestsPassRegistryValidation` | `registry_test.go` | — | Enforcement layer 1 over everything this repo ships: every property named in a manifest's static needs/provides schemas is canonical for its entity type or vendor-namespaced (SPEC §4a). |

[spec/wire/README.md](https://github.com/gtme-run/gtme/blob/main/spec/wire/README.md) says how a wire transcript is recorded and which schema each of its lines must meet.
